title: I could NOT escape that building last night. It was never ending!
content: I was in this building, it was like a weird hybrid of prison, mall, hidden cult lair, torture chamber, movie theatre, whatever. The "mall" was so sprawling and neverending and yet was located in the middle of the woods mostly underground and hidden from society. There were a LOT of horrible people inside and I really needed to get out and touch the ground and see the sky again because it had been days, I was missing and knew no one knew where the hell I was. There were a few pockets of cool places inside, like a jewelry store or bar, but most of it was full of criminals ready to do terrible things. But every time I thought I found my way back to the doorway where I first accidentally entered the building, I realized that someone had made changes and I could no longer get out that way. It would lead to an unfamiliar hallway, or section, or the door itself was now welded over with something else entirely. And if I felt like I was getting close to the exit, the hallways leading there would become narrower and narrower until I could no longer continue. Anyone else have trouble escaping the buildings? I did finally get out and I kissed the ground, but I was terrified of ending up back inside. It was very different for me because usually the buildings are very cool and I love exploring them. This was maybe my first time feeling like the walls were literally closing in on me.
